text: Legal Terms & Practice Notices
Effective Date: January 1, 2026 | Practice Disclosures & Terms of Use

If you or someone you know is experiencing a mental health emergency, suicidal thoughts, or self-harm, please do not use this website to request urgent care. Call 911 or go to your nearest emergency room immediately. You can also reach the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline by calling or texting 988 (available 24/7, free, and confidential).
1. Medical & Clinical Disclaimer

The information provided on this website is for educational and general informational purposes only and does not constitute medical, psychiatric, or healthcare advice. Browsing this website or submitting an inquiry form does not establish a provider-patient relationship. A formal provider-patient relationship is established only after completing an initial comprehensive evaluation and signing a mutual clinical care agreement.
2. Provider Licensure & Geographic Boundaries

Laura Jane Hyte Garner, APRN, PMHNP-BC, is a board-certified Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner licensed to provide clinical psychiatric evaluation and medication management services to individuals residing in and physically located within Utah, Texas, and California at the time of service.
Patients participating in telehealth sessions must be physically located in a state where the provider holds active licensure during every virtual visit.
